comments.body: @pcbeingused333 Did you test it against ollama server ?

@pcbeingused333 I am going to close this one as it looks very similar to the other full-AI-driven ones, and I am not sure this is even tested on a real provider.

The use of AI is completely fine. However, I would like to avoid some fully automated AI loop submitting PRs for the sake of submitting PRs.

It's tricky, because some of those PRs could be good fixes, but they need to be more human driven. Basically, a real issue that was experienced while using the library, and then tested with the corresponding provider (in addition of the corresponding tests)

So, if this was a real issue you had while using this crate, and you tested it with ollama, then, I am happy to reopen this PR and review it to merge.
